companyProfile.title: Tell us about your company
companyProfile.description: One quick detail before you start — it helps us show you what's relevant for your team's size. You can change it later in Settings.
companyProfile.employeeRangeLabel: How many people work at your company? *

teamSetup.title: Create your first team
teamSetup.description: A team groups your reps and defines who sees whose work. If it's just a few of you for now, feel free to skip this — create one whenever you want from Team.

tourPreview.title: How BEE works
tourPreview.description: A guided 6-step walkthrough, right on the actual product — we'll show you every key spot as you go, in the order that makes sense for your first pass.

signals.title: 1. Signals
signals.description: It all starts here: what the market already made public — a funding round, a key hire, a stack change — before anyone else notices.

darkFunnel.title: 2. Dark Funnel
darkFunnel.description: Buying intent nobody else sees: anonymous visits, comparisons, quiet research — before they ever raise a hand.

strategy.title: 3. Strategy
strategy.description: Open an opportunity and look at the play the AI put together: the argument, the channel, the email — ready to send, not a generic template.

pipeline.title: 4. Pipeline (CRM)
pipeline.description: Every already-prioritized opportunity lives here, across 5 stages: Detected → Ready to act → Your priority → In conversation → Closed. Not a generic CRM's stages ("New, Open...") — every column has its own "?" icon explaining what it means. Drag a card to move it forward.

forecast.title: 5. Forecast
forecast.description: What's going to close this month and what's at risk — calculated straight from the real pipeline, not a separate spreadsheet someone has to update by hand.

closingDashboard.title: 6. Your team
closingDashboard.description: From here you invite your team to collaborate on the same pipeline, each with the visibility that matches their role.

closingProbar.title: 6. Your turn
closingProbar.description: This was a quick spin with sample data. Create your free account to connect your own signals and watch BEE work with your real pipeline.
